key.name: output-directory
key.description: Where ripped audio files are written. When empty, the app uses the XDG Music folder (typically ~/Music).

key.name: color-scheme
key.description: Appearance: follow the system (default), force light, or force dark. Uses libadwaita StyleManager color scheme.

key.name: flac-compression
key.summary: FLAC compression level (0–8; 5 is the default, 8 is smallest)

key.name: aac-quality
key.summary: AAC quality preset (FDK VBR 1–5 or CBR)

key.name: aac-bitrate
key.summary: Deprecated AAC CBR bitrate (kbps); prefer aac-quality

key.name: also-encode
key.summary: Also encode a second (lossy) format from the same rip

key.name: also-encode-format
key.summary: Secondary encode format when Also encode is on

key.name: artwork-source-itunes
key.summary: Use Apple Music / iTunes for cover art

key.name: artwork-source-caa
key.summary: Use Cover Art Archive (MusicBrainz) for cover art

key.name: artwork-max-size
key.description: Full-resolution art is always downloaded for preview and folder cover. Before embedding into audio files, images are scaled so the longest edge is this many pixels. 0 keeps the original. Default is 1000 (sharp on modern screens; ~100–350 KB JPEG per track). Use 600–800 for older car stereos / DAPs; keep a full-size cover.jpg in the album folder.

key.name: auto-lookup-metadata
key.summary: Automatically look up metadata when a disc is detected

key.name: filename-template
key.description: Placeholders: {track}, {disc_track} (01, or 1-01 when multi-disc), {disc_prefix}, {title}, {artist}, {album_artist}, {album}, {year}, {date}, {genre}, {disc}, {totaldiscs}, {track_total}. Default uses {disc_track} so multi-disc albums do not overwrite. Settings offers common presets; Custom keeps a freeform template.

key.name: album-folder-template
key.summary: Album folder template under the output directory

key.name: artist-style
key.summary: How multiple artists appear in filenames
key.description: semicolon — A; B; C. slash — A / B / C in filenames. Tags use native multi-value artist fields. feat — title becomes "Track feat. B & C" with primary artist only in tags.

key.name: verify-accuraterip
key.description: After extraction, compare track CRCs to the AccurateRip database.

key.name: verify-ctdb
key.description: After extraction, compare track CRCs to the CUETools Database (CTDB).

key.name: submit-ctdb
key.description: After ripping, confirm a full-disc CTDB match, or submit a new parity entry when the disc is missing/unmatched and rip quality is 100 (secure test&copy). Off by default.

key.name: drive-sample-offset
key.description: AccurateRip sample offset for this drive. Set automatically by Drive setup, or manually from accuraterip.com/driveoffsets.htm.

key.name: drive-offset-configured
key.description: True after the user finishes or skips drive offset calibration.

key.name: drive-offset-device
key.summary: Device path used when the offset was calibrated

key.name: burst-fallback
key.summary: Burst mode fallback for scratched discs
key.description: Off by default for maximum secure quality. When enabled, after secure test & copy retries are exhausted, that track (or image) may be recovered once with paranoia disabled (burst mode, -Z). Burst audio is not CRC-verified and should only be used for damaged discs.

key.name: write-rip-log
key.description: After extraction, write a detailed status log into the album folder (TOC, CRC, AccurateRip, burst mode, encoder settings).

key.name: write-cue-file
key.description: After a secure rip, write a .cue sheet into the album folder. Per-track rips get a multi-file CUE with INDEX 00 pregaps appended to the previous track; Copy Image mode gets a single-file image CUE. Mixed-mode / CD-Extra data tracks are listed as MODE1/2352 or MODE2/2352 BINARY files.

key.name: test-and-copy
key.description: Extract every track twice (test then copy), compare CRC32 values, and only accept a match after up to three secure retries. Unmatched tracks fail the rip unless Burst Fallback is enabled.

key.name: rip-htoa
key.description: Enable Hidden Track One Audio handling: the standard 2-second pause before track 1 is ignored; only longer pregaps are checked. Non-silent audio is saved as track 00. Track 1 itself is never extended with the pregap (always starts at index 01). Inter-track INDEX 00 pregaps are always detected at rip start and written into the CUE sheet.

key.name: rip-data-tracks
key.summary: Rip mixed-mode and CD-Extra data tracks
key.description: When the TOC includes a data track (mixed-mode CD or CD-Extra / enhanced CD), extract it as a raw 2352-byte .bin (MODE1/2352 or MODE2/2352) and list it in the CUE sheet. Audio extraction is unchanged. A failed data extract fails the rip.

key.name: copy-image
key.description: When enabled, rip one continuous image file for the disc instead of separate per-track files. Enable Write .cue file for a matching image CUE sheet. FLAC or WAV is used for the image (lossy formats fall back to FLAC).

key.name: auto-rip
key.summary: Automatically start ripping when a disc is inserted
key.description: When enabled, ready2rip starts a full-disc rip shortly after a new audio CD is detected (tray closed, media ready).

key.name: auto-eject
key.summary: Eject the disc after a successful rip
key.description: When enabled, open the drive tray after a rip finishes successfully.
